subject: The last time through
previewText: One sentence at the end of every song, and your singers walk in remembering the bridge.
opening:
Hi everyone!

Think about school. People study math and languages all the way up to summer, then for three months they kind of forget, and they have to be refreshed to get back to where they were. If only they had been working on it right before they came back, they could keep going. This is how we should do it with music.
tryThis:
At the end of each run-through, when you're done and about to move on to the next song, say: this will be the last time. That should be a cue for everybody to pull out their phones, get their voice memo recording going, and record that time.

Then they listen on the way to the next rehearsal and sing along. Oh, right, that's how the bridge goes. They walk in the door remembering it, and you've saved yourself all that remedial time.

**Recording devices are your friend.** And if you need to tell everyone to put their phone in airplane mode and knock it off with the Candy Crush the rest of the time, that makes sense too.
